contracts: Native thread background process identities are discovered with bounded pagination, distinct from browser terminal IDs and standalone process handles.

Single-process terminate requires a reviewed discovered identity; terminated:false stays explicit and list refreshes. Whole-thread clean is confirmed, includes newly appeared native processes, and is never described as OS cleanup proof.

Explicit per-thread shell runs only after full-history/loaded/idle admission and unsandboxed consent. Native submission is not command completion; output and stopping remain in canonical conversation history.
Unknown operations only query original durable receipts. New drafts typed during submission are retained.
